heading.title: Of Offences Relating to Coin, Currency-Notes, Bank-Notes, and Government Stamps

article.title: Unlawfully taking coining instrument from mint
article.content: Whoever, without lawful authority, takes out of any mint, lawfully established in India, any coining tool or instrument, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
article.html:
188Unlawfully taking coining instrument from mint

Section 188 · Chapter X

Whoever, without lawful authority, takes out of any mint, lawfully established in India, any coining tool or instrument, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
